# Khronos SciFiHelmet source asset

This directory vendors the original Khronos glTF Sample Assets
`SciFiHelmet` source used as the starting point for the KYX.IO helmet fit.

- Upstream: https://github.com/KhronosGroup/glTF-Sample-Assets/tree/main/Models/SciFiHelmet
- Model license: CC0 1.0 (`LICENSE.md`)
- Metadata license: CC BY 4.0, as declared by `metadata.json`
- Imported asset remains a separately named third-party source. Any fitted,
  retopologized, or recolored KYX.IO derivative must retain this notice.
